raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 payments-source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records and leaves the original POSTED. silver_transactions keeps every POSTED original, so reversed amounts are still counted and gold totals run high. The fix is to exclude POSTED originals that have a matching REVERSAL record, using NOT EXISTS so that null orig_txn_id values do not break the filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
